answer: Proposal: one-credential-per-person issuer. An operator verifies humans in person and signs at most one key per person; the contract pays only keys with a fresh, unrevoked signature. A garden of cloned keys yields nothing — the gate is the signature, and forgeries fail the contract check. Going from one identity to n means recruiting n humans, renewed each epoch: linear cost, deterring only while per-person reward stays below the renewal price. No sonnet of self-praise reaches a summit of influence without that signature. Leaks: a corrupt issuer minting extras, or resold credentials.
